C1.rationale: Level 3: Structured communication of complex disciplinary concepts and technical arguments to diverse stakeholders in insurance and actuarial studies.
evidenceLines: If you are considering ETC5550 or ETC5345, you may only complete one of these units to count towards your 42 credit points.
The following units are specifically allocated for actuarial exemption/accreditation purposes: ETC5252, ETC5256, ETC5342, ETC5343, ETC5346, ETC5352, ETC5353, ETC5550, ETC5345
This course will prepare you to work in actuarial and risk management fields.

C2.rationale: Level 3: Critical evaluation of methodological assumptions, disciplinary arguments, and professional evidence in insurance and actuarial studies.
evidenceLines: apply the principles of double-entry accounting and appraise the relative merits of accrual and cash accounting
describe and apply the definition and recognition criteria for assets, liabilities, income and expenses as specified in the conceptual framework
You will also progress toward qualifications to become an accredited Actuary.

C3.rationale: Level 3: Disciplinary problem solving applying quantitative, computational, or analytical frameworks within insurance and actuarial studies.
evidenceLines: Subject: Introduction to financial accounting (ACF5950)
Subject: Corporate finance  (BFC2140)
apply principles of selected accounting standards for service and retail organisations

C4.rationale: Level 3: Interdisciplinary integration connecting core principles, professional practices, and evolving industry standards in insurance and actuarial studies.
evidenceLines: analyse and record accounting transactions throughout the accounting cycle, and prepare financial statements consistent with accounting standards
demonstrate effective technical skills to construct accounting records and financial statements using an accounting information system
Depending on academic results you may receive accreditation for the Foundation Program and most of the Actuary Program recognised by the Actuaries Institute.

C5.rationale: Level 2: Applied investigation and empirical project work addressing real-world challenges in insurance and actuarial studies.
evidenceLines: Subject: Advanced foundations of finance  (BFF5520)
Subject: Quantitative and data analysis in Python (BFF5525)
critically evaluate an entity's financial position and performance utilising financial statement analysis.
